summary.json.measurement: added p95 is the p95 of the worker zirv_flow_decision_append_seconds histogram (one observation per decision append call, bucket interpolation) on the on build; the off build records none (off_append_observations). The throughput loss is (on - off) / on of the drain time, paired per round; rounds are interleaved and alternate the side that goes first. Per run: docker stats, pg_stat_wal and pg_stat_statements before and after the drain, and the wait sampler, in <side><n>.instrument/.
